## Checklist

- [ ] Title, description, and new copy are in English
- [ ] CI green (`test`)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private infra in the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`) if a user or operator will notice
- [ ] Docs (`docs/api/`, `docs/map.md`, `docs/flows/`) if routes, contract, or UI changed
